items.title: Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley set to reap $113 million from Anthropic IPO
items.summary: Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley could each collect roughly $113 million in fees for leading Anthropic's (ANT) initial public offering on Thursday.

items.title: Jim Cramer’s Warning for Anyone Buying Anthropic Stock: Use a Limit Order
items.summary: Anthropic opened far above its IPO price, then gave back a chunk of that gain within hours. Cramer says one small choice at the buy button separates smart entries from costly ones, and most retail buyers never see it coming.

items.title: Goldman Sachs Forecasts 17% S&P 500 Rally in 2027 as AI Investment Supports Earnings Growth
items.summary: Goldman Sachs expects the S&P 500 to rise 17% to 8,700 points by the end of 2027, supported by continued investment in artificial intelligence and resilient US economic growth, although the bank anticipates more moderate equity returns as corporate earnings growth slows. The investment bank expects the US stock market to maintain its upward trajectory, but at a slower pace than the annualised return of 21% recorded over the previous four years.

items.title: Goldman, Morgan Stanley to Each Earn Over $110 Million in Anthropic IPO Fees
